claims.text: Direct Lake on OneLake is chosen for OneLake security, more modelling features, and faster query performance.
Direct Lake on SQL applies when SQL analytics endpoint security rules are needed or DirectQuery fallback is required.
A semantic model in Direct Lake mode loads columns from Delta tables in OneLake on demand rather than importing all data.
